question.problem:
The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below. Which of the following is true when $x\rightarrow 2?$   

I. $f(x) \rightarrow  \infty$

II. $f(x) \rightarrow  2$

III. $f(x) \rightarrow  -\infty$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14227291/assets/33650d66a0f3a2fae762b1c19da952597740868b00eeec11a14ad822536962e8.png)
question.worked_solution:
From the given graph, we see that as $x$ approaches $2,$ the values of $f(x)$ increase, approaching $\infty.$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14227291/assets/4585f983dac68f3ac655fbaaed6481cd1479c4cffae2c10d9f08d991c6533f51.png)

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
